interface_authority: Actual registered source/runtime and describe_engine take precedence over latest public documentation. Parameters must map to emitted config/API/CLI; no invented effective controls.

zh-CN: 按实际版本检查 CV、Bias、Switch、Neighbor 库和图节点，区分源码默认值、示例值、结构推导值和试运行提案。
核对物种、原子索引、周期镜像、张量形状和收集顺序。CoordNum(n_atoms, switch) 给出长度为 n_atoms 的逐中心向量。即使只筛标记中心的边，mean 仍除以 n_atoms。用对应索引切片取一个分量，并核对实际图能否表达筛边和取值。
固定谐波伞窗可用 FlexibleWallBias，上下限设为同一中心，两侧刚度相同，步进和增长设零。WTMetaD 的 sigma、scale 按完整 CV 顺序排列，普通高斯基类的 scale 通过非零值选分量。
WTMetaDGaussianBias 使用 sigma、weight、scale、temp、bias_factor。使用周期类时区分构造器 pdl 和字典配置 cv_wrap，配位数通常没有周期域。OPES 走自己的过程、状态、续跑和重加权。
让 GAScfg 的 n_atoms、cv_size、neighbor_rc、max_neighbors 与结构及模型一致，按目标驱动安排写日志、沉积和历史容量。CV 顺序或定义改变后，重核关联参数和产物。
若库或图不能表达所需 CV，先明确公式、定义域、单位和需补的操作。实际目标分别验证序列化模型重载、真实邻居表、偏置力和位力。
en: Use the actual CV, bias, switch and neighbor catalog and graph for the selected version. Keep source defaults, tutorial values, structure-derived choices and pilot proposals distinct.

Check species, atom indices, periodic images and collector dimensions and order. CoordNum(n_atoms, switch) returns a length-n_atoms vector. Filtering edges to the tagged center still leaves mean dividing by n_atoms. Take a one-element slice at the tagged index and verify the graph can express the filtering and gather.

FlexibleWallBias can produce a fixed harmonic umbrella with equal bounds and stiffnesses and zero step and growth terms. Keep WTMetaD sigma and scale in full CV order. The ordinary Gaussian base uses nonzero scale entries to select CV components.

WTMetaDGaussianBias takes sigma, weight, scale, temp and bias_factor. For a periodic class distinguish constructor pdl from dictionary cv_wrap and state the CV domain. A coordination CV is normally nonperiodic. Use the separate OPES procedure, state, restart and reweighting contract.

Match GAScfg n_atoms, cv_size, neighbor_rc and max_neighbors to the structure and model. Use the target driver for log and deposition intervals and history capacity. Recheck dependent parameters and artifacts when CV order or definition changes.

If the library graph cannot express the CV, specify its formula, domain, units and required operations. Reload the serialized artifact and check real-neighbor forces and virial on the selected target.

applicability.selected_runtime: Executable/module capability is NOT verified by this document. Use selected registered runtime probe, exact executable/module identities and consumer validation.

applicability.installation: No grant, install, branch change or submission is authorized by this reference. Do not attach install bodies on normal calculation turns.
